mapper.select: SELECT id, chapter_id AS chapterId, title, version_label AS versionLabel, script_json AS scriptJson FROM classroom_scripts WHERE review_status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'VERIFIED') ORDER BY chapter_id, title, id

SELECT id, chapter_id AS chapterId, title, version_label AS versionLabel, script_json AS scriptJson FROM classroom_scripts WHERE review_status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'VERIFIED') AND chapter_id = #{chapterId} ORDER BY title, id
SELECT id, chapter_id AS chapterId, title, version_label AS versionLabel, script_json AS scriptJson FROM classroom_scripts WHERE id = #{id} AND review_status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'VERIFIED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO classroom_sessions (id, user_id, script_id, state, paused, script_json_snapshot, chapter_id_snapshot) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{scriptId}, #{state}, #{paused}, #{scriptJson}, #{chapterId})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.user_id AS userId, s.script_id AS scriptId, COALESCE(s.chapter_id_snapshot, c.chapter_id) AS chapterId, s.state, s.paused, s.summary, COALESCE(s.script_json_snapshot, c.script_json) AS scriptJson FROM classroom_sessions s JOIN classroom_scripts c ON c.id = s.script_id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO classroom_ask_exchanges (session_id, step_index, question, answer) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{stepIndex}, #{question}, #{answer})
mapper.select: SELECT step_index AS stepIndex, question, answer, created_at AS createdAt FROM classroom_ask_exchanges WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'ANSWER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS answers, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN action = 'HINT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hints FROM classroom_events WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND step_index = #{stepIndex}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO classroom_events (session_id, action, content, from_state, to_state, answer_status, misconception, feedback, step_index, question_id, attempt_no, hint_used) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{action}, #{content}, #{fromState}, #{toState}, #{answerStatus}, #{misconception}, #{feedback}, #{stepIndex}, #{questionId}, #{attemptNo}, #{hintUsed})
mapper.select: SELECT k.chapter_id AS chapterId, k.source_path AS sourcePath, MIN(k.title) AS title FROM knowledge_chunks k JOIN chapters c ON c.id = k.chapter_id WHERE (k.source_path LIKE 'textbook/%' OR k.source_path LIKE 'courseware/%') AND k.review_status = 'VERIFIED' AND k.resource_id IS NULL AND k.license_scope IN ('PUBLIC','CLASSROOM_ONLY') AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' GROUP BY k.chapter_id, k.source_path ORDER BY k.source_path

SELECT k.source_path AS sourcePath, k.page_label AS pageLabel FROM knowledge_chunks k JOIN chapters c ON c.id = k.chapter_id WHERE (k.source_path LIKE 'textbook/%' OR k.source_path LIKE 'courseware/%') AND k.review_status = 'VERIFIED' AND k.resource_id IS NULL AND k.license_scope IN ('PUBLIC','CLASSROOM_ONLY') AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT id, content, page_label FROM knowledge_chunks WHERE source_path = #{sourcePath} AND chapter_id = #{chapterId} AND review_status = 'VERIFIED' AND resource_id IS NULL AND license_scope IN ('PUBLIC','CLASSROOM_ONLY') ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO classroom_scripts (id, chapter_id, title, version_label, review_status, script_json) VALUES (#{id}, #{chapterId}, #{title}, 'runtime-json-v1', 'DRAFT', #{scriptJson})
mapper.select: SELECT runtime_index AS runtimeIndex, runtime_revision AS runtimeRevision, runtime_response AS runtimeResponse FROM classroom_sessions WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classroom_events WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND action = #{action}
SELECT slide_id FROM classroom_slide_overrides WHERE script_id = #{scriptId} AND step_index = #{stepIndex}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO classroom_slide_overrides (script_id, step_index, slide_id, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{scriptId}, #{stepIndex}, #{slideId}, #{updatedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE slide_id = VALUES(slide_id), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
